# Technically Speaking

> A six-week communication program that teaches engineers and technical teams to make the business case — to win executive buy-in, align stakeholders, handle pushback, and move decisions forward without the CTO in the room. Built on the TECH Model, created by Michaud Garneau.

Technically Speaking teaches technical people how to "speak business": to sit across from clients, product teams and executives and move decisions forward. It is a live, cohort-based program, not a one-off course. Every participant is measured against the TECH rubric at the start and end, so improvement is tracked, not assumed.

## The TECH Model
A shared way to think through any message, pitch or conversation before it happens:
- **T — Target Audience:** Who am I talking to? What matters to them, and to the business?
- **E — End Goal:** What decision am I trying to make happen, and am I asking for it clearly?
- **C — Clarity:** What do they actually need to know, tied to why it matters to them?
- **H — How You Say It:** Pace, tone, pauses — how you earn attention and land the point.

## The program (facts)
- Format: six weeks, once a week, 90-minute live sessions.
- Cohort size: six participants.
- Price: $18,000 per cohort ($3,000 per person).
- Includes: pre-program discovery and customization, six live sessions with personalized feedback, baseline and endline assessments on the TECH rubric, the TECH AI Coach for practice between sessions, a final pitch to a real executive, and sponsor check-ins at three and six months.
- Who it's for: engineers, engineering managers, and customer-facing technical people, brought in by CTOs, VPs and Directors.

## Proof
- Jungle Scout — Sam Johnson, CTO: after the program, an engineering manager handled a live incident with executives while Sam was away. "Proposals now hit the points I care about, so we can get to decisions a lot more quickly."
- TextNow — Andrew Cotton, Head of Security, Compliance & IT: "I talk to my CFO and COO completely differently now. I learned to get to the real problem underneath what people say."
- MLSE — Katee Carrasco, Director, Global Partnerships: a participant used what they learned on a client call the same afternoon as the first session.
- Other clients: CTO Craft, SaaS North, TechTO.

## Founder
Michaud Garneau — creator of the TECH Model, founder of Technically Speaking. 10+ years teaching technical people to communicate, from startups to Fortune 500. TEDx speaker; LinkedIn Learning instructor.
